video_title: He Played 17 Years in the NBA. Now He's the One Telling the Stories.

quotes.speaker: CJ Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: CJ Miles on the heavy bias in modern NBA journalism
quotes.excerpt: A lot of journalism now has a lot of heavy bias in it. It's never just about the game.
quotes.quote: A lot of journalism now has a lot of heavy bias in it. It's never just about the game. It's about this conversation they bring in to dress around the game, the relationship they have with a player they don't like or haven't liked. That shit is nasty and disgusting right now.

quotes.speaker: CJ Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: CJ Miles on critiquing players without being disrespectful
quotes.excerpt: You know how to critique without disrespecting. There's no line in the sand no more.
quotes.quote: You know how to critique without disrespecting. There's no line in the sand no more. It's attacking them for not playing well or something they did instead of critiquing the performance.

quotes.speaker: CJ Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: CJ Miles on why more players should enter sports media
quotes.excerpt: They take the game with all the replays, the hindsight, and they form it into this language.
quotes.quote: They take the game with all the replays, the hindsight, and they form it into this language that players always can't articulate. Or like you watch Wemby after the last game, they're asking him questions like, 'I don't know,' because we speak differently. We speak with our actions. That's what the athletes do in the arena. So when the game ends and you ask me these questions, I just talked for three hours. You want me to put it in your language so you can understand, but you would never understand it completely. I need time. And that's what I try to do. I try to be that bridge.

quotes.speaker: CJ Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: CJ Miles on how NBA teams scouted him in high school
quotes.excerpt: I didn't know I was being looked at by NBA teams until I finished my senior year.
quotes.quote: I didn't know I was being looked at by NBA teams until I finished my senior year of basketball. My high school coach, my parents, they were able to keep that away from me. You cannot do that now.

quotes.speaker: CJ Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: CJ Miles on the negative impact of older players in college
quotes.excerpt: It's dangerous for the game. You're messing with the future of the game too.
quotes.quote: It's dangerous for the game. You're messing with the future of the game too. Because you got these kids and these players coming up, they're discouraged and they got these different routes. They're going to get lost in the shuffle. And it's keeping it a bean, like we're not drafting none of them kids.

quotes.speaker: CJ Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: CJ Miles on the loss of development time for young players
quotes.excerpt: Those two years that at a D1 that would have made me a pro is gone.
quotes.quote: Those two years that at a D1 that would have made me a pro is gone, because I'm in the shuffle. No disrespect, no JUCOs and all these different things, but I get lost in that and I don't get the right things I need. And now we're looking for players again, and now we're complaining about this, that, and the third. And you we did it.
